value.rationale: Four states are the first nontrivial small-state case with a genuine binary separation of the second and third winning classes. The sharp alphabet-specific collapse at 3 is not implied by the general 6-cutoff, and the exact full outcome and orbit distributions supply a motivated finite benchmark for adversarial synchronization rather than an arbitrary isolated sample. The witness and complete classification expose robust control differences under bounded replies.
